indicator_definitions.bar_eligibility: bar_start + 60 seconds <= decision_at; regular session 09:30 to 16:00 New York only; missing bars are not filled.
indicator_definitions.ema: SMA seed over first N observed closes, then alpha=2/(N+1); carry across sessions.
indicator_definitions.rsi_14: Wilder smoothing of 14 close-to-close gains and losses; carry across sessions; zero gains and losses gives 50.
indicator_definitions.atr_14: Wilder smoothing of max(high-low, abs(high-previous_close), abs(low-previous_close)); carry across sessions.
indicator_definitions.macd: EMA12 minus EMA26; signal is SMA-seeded EMA9 of valid MACD values.
indicator_definitions.session_vwap_hlc3: Sum((high+low+close)/3 * reported_volume) / sum(reported_volume) over completed current-session bars; null before first completed bar.
indicator_definitions.volume_ratio: Last completed bar reported volume divided by mean of preceding 20 observed bars; can cross sessions.
indicator_definitions.returns: Close-to-close over 5 or 20 observed bars, including overnight boundaries; not necessarily 5 or 20 wall-clock minutes.
